== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]] is a prestigious competition organized by the surviving [[Monarchs]] and great families to cultivate a new generation of powerful leaders. Established following the conclusion of the [[Dread War]], the event serves as an exhibition of military strength intended to deter aggression from rivals like the [[Dragon King]] and to secure support from other major families. The tournament is designed for young [[sacred artists]] under the age of thirty-five, specifically targeting those at the [[Underlord]] stage. Participation is open to various groups, including the [[Akura clan]]'s vassal states and the [[Arelius family]]. The competition progresses through multiple rounds of elimination, including single-elimination duels. The top eight fighters are honored as the Uncrowned. These individuals receive a unique, permanent spiritual mark known as the [[Broken Crown]], which serves as an unmistakable signature of their status and strength. Beyond this recognition, participants receive personal instruction from a [[Sage]]. The top four competitors receive additional rewards consisting of seven hand-picked gifts from the other participating teams. Success in the tournament is highly significant, as previous top finishers have gone on to become [[Heralds]], [[Sages]], or ascended beings. However, the tournament maintains specific restrictions, such as prohibiting [[Archlord|Archlords]], [[Heralds]], or those who have advanced past the Overlord stage from competing.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The Uncrowned is a tournament structured around a series of single-elimination duels. Participants compete through various stages, where winning a round grants the right to eventually become one of the Uncrowned. The competition ultimately determines which eight individuals will be chosen from the final elimination round. This selection process concludes when the true Uncrowned Kings are revealed.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Uncrowned is a recognized status and tournament held within an arena where individuals are selected to possess a unique signature. As the competition reaches its fourth round, [[Blacksword]] is virtually guaranteed a spot, while two of the eight participants are expected to be [[Blackflame Underlords]]. Although [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara|Sha Miara]] was anticipated to compete, eliminated participants were sent aboard the [[Akura family cloudship|Akura cloudship]]. During the fifth round, increased security caused the competitors to be separated, though they remain permitted to interact outside of their matches. Access to the waiting rooms behind the arenas is strictly limited to the Uncrowned and their sponsors, a rank that [[Lindon]] does not yet hold. [[Reigan Shen]] eventually claimed responsibility for three of the eight members, and at one point, four enemy competitors were positioned behind [[Lindon]].}}
